title: Phase 1: LLM Model Backend
description:
Enable LLM-powered predictions through the Model interface. Create LLMModelBackend that internally uses an Agent with conversation loop for classification, but presents the predict() interface to callers. Add cost tracking for LLM token usage.

Part of the Model Primitive MLOps vision (docs/MODEL_PRIMITIVE_PLAN.md).
